Track #288 review note — `/code-review 307 high`, post-merge into `kb/track-288`.

The ~370 JSDoc edits were checked as behaviour-neutral one by one (the `cli.js` `Number()`
coercion, the `board.js`/`gc.js`/`model.js`/`gh.js`/`serve.js` casts, `hook.js`'s `found` local,
`lifecycle.js`'s `title = ''`) — all equivalent at runtime. The findings were in the build and CI
contract the new `lint` script created.

Fixed on the track branch (commits 0fabaeb, 18bd037):

1. **`release.yml` had no `npm install`** (high). `npm run lint` now ends in `tsc --noEmit`, and with
   no lock file nothing is restored — a `v*` tag would have died at `sh: 1: tsc: not found` before
   anything was published. `test.yml` got the step; `release.yml` did not. Added, with
   `test/release.test.js` updated to pin the step order.
2. **`bin/hkb.js` reimplemented the printing** (medium). Node registers its default `warning` listener
   only when warnings are enabled, so the unconditional `process.on` *resurrected* warnings under
   `--no-warnings` / `NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1`, and `--no-deprecation`, `--throw-deprecation`,
   `--trace-warnings`, `warning.code`, `warning.detail` and the `(node:pid)` prefix are all the
   default listener's doing. It is now captured and re-invoked; three new tests in `test/cli.test.js`
   pin the flags.
3. **`typescript` floated at `^5.9.3`** (low) against a plain `npm install` with no committed lock, so
   a new 5.x minor could turn lint red on an unrelated PR with nothing to roll back to. Both
   devDependencies pinned exactly.
4. **`npm run typecheck` died as `sh: 1: tsc: not found`** in any checkout that had not run
   `npm install` — every fresh worker worktree (medium). It now prints a one-line message naming the
   fix and lint stays green there; the type check remains a CI gate.

Left as-is, recorded here rather than fixed:

5. `src/gc.js:119`/`:145` — `finished` and `prByBranch` are annotated optional (`finished?:`) but have
   no default and are called unconditionally, so `sweepWorktrees(ctx, {})` type-checks and throws at
   runtime. They should be required in the annotation. Not fixed: `src/gc.js` is in #291's paths.
6. `src/projects.js:136` — the `boardLabel` description was reattached to `maxAdds`, merging two
   options' prose into one sentence and leaving `boardLabel` undocumented. Also #291's path.
7. `src/doctor.js:712`, `src/lifecycle.js:226`, `src/init.js:451`, `src/serve.js:330`,
   `src/model.js:684` — the new `@param`/`@returns` blocks were added as a *second* JSDoc comment
   between the existing prose block and the declaration. Only the immediately preceding comment
   attaches, so the rationale those functions carry no longer shows on hover. Merging the tags into
   the existing block keeps both. All five files are in #291's paths.

results.summary: Node floor is now >=22.13 (24 recommended) and `npm run lint` type-checks the JSDoc. bin/hkb.js carries the SQLite ExperimentalWarning filter verbatim from docs/local-first.md §9 and loads src/cli.js via a DYNAMIC `await import()` — a static import is hoisted above the filter and would defeat it; keep it dynamic. tsconfig.json is a checker, not a build (noEmit, allowJs+checkJs, strict:false) over bin/, src/, scripts/ and types/. New types/hkb.d.ts declares the two shapes plain JS cannot: `Error` with .exitCode/.userMessage/.kind/.needs/... (CLAUDE.md's own rule, read back at ~60 sites) and `HkbAttempt`, one run-record row whose fields are written in stages — later nodes adding attempt fields should add them there rather than casting at the construction site. ~370 type errors were fixed as JSDoc only; no @ts-expect-error was needed and no runtime behaviour changed (four non-comment edits, each behaviour-identical: an explicit Number() around an already-coercing comparator in cli.js, a cast's closing paren in board.js, a `?.` rewritten through a local in hook.js, and `title = ''` as createTask's default in lifecycle.js, which the existing guard rejects exactly as it rejected undefined). typescript and @types/node are devDependencies; nothing under src/ imports either, so `node bin/hkb.js version` in a fresh clone with no npm install still works and the packed tarball is unaffected. No lock file is committed and package-lock.json is now gitignored — CI runs a plain `npm install` before lint and every setup-node keeps package-manager-cache:false, which requires the lock file to stay absent. CI is now four jobs: test on 22 and 24, smoke on 22 and 26; smoke deliberately runs NO npm install because the tarball must work with nothing installed beside it. A2 (remove the Actions runner) can proceed on this branch as-is; note that .github/workflows/test.yml now has matrices in both jobs.
